question: Where are an attraction within 80 kilometers of Two Rivers, WI in the southeast direction?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin(geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Two Rivers%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 80000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Two Rivers%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 )), geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
